release_title: Gemini 3.1 Pro: A smarter model for your most complex tasks

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.variant: Preview at launch; based on Gemini 3 Pro; Thinking levels low/medium/high (table column: Thinking High)
models.capability_summary: Google 将 Gemini 3.1 Pro 定位为「为最复杂任务打造的更聪明模型」，基于 Gemini 3 Pro，发布时为 preview（thinking 档 low/medium/high）。已收录 19 项评测横跨推理、代码、多模态与长上下文：亮点 GPQA 94.3%、SWE-bench Verified 80.6%。

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark hlehle. Companion row with Search+Code tools recorded separately.

Maps to existing benchmark arc-agi variant 2. The release blog's headline number ('verified score of 77.1%... more than double 3 Pro'). Third-party-verified lane — distinct from Gemini 3 Deep Think's 45.1% with-code-execution row (different tool condition).

locator.heading: Performance

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark gpqa (canonical Diamond).

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: Terminal-Bench 2.0 — Agentic terminal coding / Terminus-2 harness

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark terminalbench variant 2.0. Same-harness lane (Terminus-2) as Muse Glimmer's TB 2.1 row — but different TB VERSION (2.0 vs 2.1); still not interchangeable. Table also carries an 'Other best self-reported harness' sub-row where GPT-5.3-Codex reaches 77.3 (Codex harness) — GPT-5.2 62.2 (Codex); Gemini columns are '—' there, so it is recorded here rather than as a comparison_cited row.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: SWE-Bench Verified — Agentic coding / Single attempt

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark swebench. Opus 4.6 edges this row at 80.8 (table column, in notes). Single-attempt condition explicit — distinct from Google's 'multiple attempts' scaffolding lane used on other pages.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: SWE-Bench Pro (Public) — Diverse agentic coding tasks / Single attempt

benchmark_evidence.notes: Reuses candidate id swebench-pro, variant Public — same lane later used for Gemini 3.6's 58.7% and Grok 4.5's 64.7% (Grok's page does not state the Public qualifier; variant alignment needed before cross-vendor ranking).

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: LiveCodeBench Pro — Competitive coding problems from Codeforces, ICPC, and IOI / Elo

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark lcb with variant Pro — LiveCodeBench Pro is a competitive-programming Elo edition, NOT comparable to pass-rate LCB windows (10/01-02/01 etc.) used elsewhere in the library; Elo vs percent metrics must never be merged.
Reuses candidate id scicode (registered batch 3). Same benchmark as Muse Glimmer's 43.6% (High reasoning).
Reuses candidate id apex-agents (registered batch 1). Nearly doubles Gemini 3 Pro (18.4).

Reuses candidate id gdpval-aa. Page label is GDPval-AA WITHOUT the v2 suffix used on Google's later pages and Meta's methodology (GDPVal-AA v2, 220 tasks, AA Stirrup harness, human baseline 1000) — variant left null here and flagged: same-family id, edition uncertainty recorded rather than assumed.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: τ2-bench — Agentic and tool use / Retail

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark tau2-bench variant Retail (canonical id for the τ²/τ2 generation; claude-haiku-4-5 and gpt-5 use the same tau2-bench Retail/Telecom lanes). Page row label is τ2-bench. 2026-09-01 audit: id corrected from tau-bench to tau2-bench — tau-bench is the τ1 generation in the catalog.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: τ2-bench — Agentic and tool use / Telecom

benchmark_evidence.notes: Saturation territory (tied with Opus 4.6 at 99.3); 1-point differences are noise. Secondary sources tie Grok 4.3's 'τ²-Bench Telecom 98%' claim to this same τ2 Telecom lane.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: MCP Atlas — Multi-step workflows using MCP

benchmark_evidence.notes: Reuses candidate id mcp-atlas. No Public/Private split stated on this page (Muse Glimmer's row is explicitly the Public split; Meta's methodology describes 500+500 public/private splits) — split alignment needed before comparing 69.2 vs 75.5.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: BrowseComp — Agentic search / Search + Python + Browse

benchmark_evidence.notes: Reuses candidate id browsecomp (registered batch 1). Tool stack explicit in the row label — comparability-critical vs tool-free BrowseComp numbers.

locator.heading: Performance
locator.row: MMMU-Pro — Multimodal understanding and reasoning / No tools

benchmark_evidence.notes: Maps to existing benchmark mmmu variant Pro. Gemini 3 Pro slightly ahead (81.0) on this row.

new-benchmark: mmmlu (Multilingual MMLU Q&A) not in data/benchmarks/ — distinct from global-mmlu-lite (Lite edition used on other Google pages) and from multilingual-mmlu (Meta's label); three sibling ids now exist for multilingual MMLU variants, migration must keep them separate or unify with explicit edition variants.

protocol.judge: Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015（论文初始版数据 2,998 条细则的判分模型；仓库 v1.1 改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，同一判分提示词）

benchmark_evidence.notes: AppCIF-Bench 官方仓库 Leaderboard 表中「Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview」行的 SSR L1 列（SSR 软满足率 = 被满足的细则占全部细则的比例；本列分母为 727 条细则）。本列为该难度档的分档数值。口径警示：榜单是中文版数据、论文初始版 2,998 条细则、由 Doubao-Seed-1.6-1015 判分；仓库现发布 v1.1（466 样本 / 3,017 条细则）并改用 Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite 判分，官方明示两套分数不可直接比较，故本行数值不代表该模型在 v1.1 上的表现。同列竞品（取本表其他行数值）：GPT-5.4-xhigh 79.1 / Doubao-Seed-2.0-Pro-high 66.6 / GLM-5.1 65.2 / Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 66.4 / Kimi-K2.5-Thinking 60.4 / Qwen-3.6-Plus-Thinking 57.4 / Grok-4.2 55.3 / DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 48.0 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Pro 42.0 / Minimax-M2.7 35.5 / Xiaomi-MiMo-V2-Omni 39.1。该列最佳：Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview 82.4。榜单由基准所有者（腾讯）自建自跑并自报，非第三方独立评测，横向比较仅限同一判分模型与同一数据版本内。AppCIF 榜单标签「Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview」对应账本 release gemini-3-1-pro / model gemini-3-1-pro。官方原始页面归档 models/2026-11-05-appcif-bench/；数据集与评测代码 https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/AppCIF-Bench ；项目页 https://ac2333.github.io/AppCIF/ 。

notes: Fills the flagged Google 3.1-series gap. Release date 2026-02-19 from the official blog.google announcement (publishedTime 2026-02-19; page 'Today, we're releasing... 3.1 Pro'; multiple timezone-consistent secondary confirmations). PRIMARY EVIDENCE SOURCE is the DeepMind product page deepmind.google/models/gemini/pro/ fetched directly — a full DOM-text benchmark table (machine-readable, no image dependency) whose columns are Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking (High) vs Gemini 3 Pro (High) / Sonnet 4.6 (Max) / Opus 4.6 (Max) / GPT-5.2 (xhigh) / GPT-5.3-Codex (xhigh). Thinking-effort levels DIFFER per column (High vs Max vs xhigh) — the table compares models at different reasoning depths, a comparability caveat the page itself creates. 19 verified rows (HLE two conditions, ARC-AGI-2, GPQA, TB 2.0 Terminus-2, SWE-bench Verified single-attempt, SWE-bench Pro Public, LCB Pro Elo, SciCode, APEX-Agents, GDPval-AA, τ2 Retail+Telecom, MCP Atlas, BrowseComp, MMMU-Pro, MMMLU, MRCR v2 128k+1M). Competitor column values kept in row notes per established 口径 (table columns, not independent prose citations); no comparison_cited rows created. Blog prose adds only the ARC-AGI-2 77.1% headline (already in table). Model card (deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-3-1-pro, results 'as of February 2026') and evals-methodology page linked but not separately harvested. IMPORTANT finding for the timeline: NO standalone 'Gemini 3.1 Flash' text model exists — the 3.1 Flash tier shipped only as Flash-Lite (2026-03-03 preview), Flash Live (audio, 2026-03-26), Flash TTS (2026-04-15) and Flash Image/Nano Banana 2 (2026-02-26); the next text Flash was 3.5 Flash (2026-05-19). Vertex model-versioning docs corroborate (no gemini-3.1-flash entry).
